Question: Triangle ABC is rotated counterclockwise through \(90^\circ\) about C. How do you construct the image of A?

Choices.A: Construct a line through A perpendicular to CA, and choose any point on this line as A′
Choices.B: Join C to A, construct \(\angle ACA'=90^\circ\), and mark off \(CA'=AB\)
Choices.C: Join C to A, construct \(\angle ACA'=90^\circ\) in the counterclockwise direction, and mark off \(CA'=CA\)

Solution: To construct an image under rotation, join the center of rotation to the point, construct the angle of rotation in the specified direction, and then mark off a length on the new ray equal to the original segment, namely \(CA'=CA\).

Original.prompt: 把 △ABC 绕点 C 逆时针旋转 90°，如何作 A 的对应点？

choices.text: 过 A 作 CA 的垂线，在垂线上任取一点作为 A′
连 CA，作 ∠ACA′=90°（逆时针方向），截取 CA′=CA

Original.explanation: 作旋转像：连接旋转中心与对应点，按方向作旋转角，再在新射线上截取与原线段相等的长度，即 CA′=CA。
